data.one_liner: Animated Firestore list, grid and staggered widgets that react to realtime updates.
data.what_it_does: Provides FirestoreAnimatedList, FirestoreAnimatedGrid, and FirestoreAnimatedStaggered widgets. They listen to a Firestore query stream and animate insertions, removals, and moves. Custom callbacks allow filtering and debugging.
use_when: You need a realtime list or grid UI backed by Cloud Firestore
You want automatic animations for data changes without writing manual diff logic
avoid_when: You require fine‑grained control over animations beyond the provided defaults
You are not using Firestore as a data source
strengths: Zero boilerplate for animated Firestore lists
Supports list, grid and staggered layouts
weaknesses: Tied to Firestore; not usable with other backends
Adds another dependency on flutter_staggered_grid_view for staggered grids
data.setup_notes: Add firestore_ui, firebase_core and cloud_firestore to pubspec; ensure Firebase is initialized in main() with Firebase.initializeApp(). No code generation required.

alternatives.name: cloud_firestore
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides raw query streams; you can build custom UI and animations manually for full control
